title: Pontalume light profile
description: A Pontalume light profile: which lamp to talk to, which colour each Teams presence state maps to, and the raw bytes to send. This schema is an editor aid; Pontalume validates every profile itself when it loads one, and names any problem it finds on the app's Debug Logs tab.

name.description: Display name, shown in the app's profile picker.

description.description: Optional free text. May be blank or absent.

characteristicUuid.description: The writable characteristic on that service.

colorMappings.description: One entry per presence state - all ten, no duplicates.

customCommands.description: The bytes sent to the lamp. Keys beyond the three below are preserved on save and never sent.

colorCommand.description: Required. Sent on every presence change. Accepts {R:X2}, {G:X2}, {B:X2} and {BR:X2}.

brightnessCommand.description: Optional. Sent after colorCommand when non-blank; its presence is also what enables the brightness slider. Accepts {BR:X2} only - {B:X2} means blue, and {A:X2} was removed.

wakeCommand.description: Optional. Sent once when the lamp becomes ready. Takes no substitution tokens.

description.description: Optional free text. May be blank or absent.
